title: Synthesis and anticancer activity of six tricyclohexyltin cinnamate complexes.
authors: Pan, Zhiyu; Zhong, Wen; Li, Yanping; Lin, Shijie; Chen, Shaofeng; Tian, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三环己基锡肉桂酸酯配合物的合成、抗癌活性及与DNA的沟槽插入结合，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是金属配合物抗癌药理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新。
abstract: Six tricyclohexyl tin cinnamate complexes (C1  approximately  C6) were successfully synthesized and were characterized. The crystal structures of C1, C2, C4, and C5 were determined. Among them, complexes C1, C2 and C5 form a one-dimensional infinite chain structure through SnO interactions or O-H...O hydrogen bonds. All complexes were tested for their inhibitory activity against human cancer cell lines A549, HepG2, and MDA-MB-231. The results showed that the C2 complex demonstrated the most significant inhibitory effect on HepG2 cells, with an IC(50) value of 1.31 +/- 0.47 muM. Preliminary studies indicate that the C2 complex induces a reduction in mitochondrial membrane potential in HepG2 cells, triggering apoptosis via the mitochondrial pathway accompanied by cell cycle arrest at the G2 phase. The DNA binding activity of C2 was investigated using ultraviolet-visible, fluorescence competition assays and molecular docking, revealing that C2 can effectively intercalate the DNA groove.
abstract_zh: 成功合成了六个三环己基锡肉桂酸配合物（C1 至 C6）并对其进行了表征。测定了C1、C2、C4和C5的晶体结构。其中，配合物C1、C2和C5通过SnO相互作用或O-H...O氢键形成一维无限链状结构。对所有配合物进行了针对人癌细胞系A549、HepG2和MDA-MB-231的抑制活性测试。结果表明，C2配合物对HepG2细胞表现出最显著的抑制效果，其IC(50)值为1.31 ± 0.47 μM。初步研究表明，C2配合物诱导HepG2细胞线粒体膜电位降低，通过线粒体途径触发细胞凋亡，并伴随细胞周期阻滞于G2期。利用紫外-可见光谱、荧光竞争实验和分子对接研究了C2的DNA结合活性，揭示C2能有效嵌入DNA沟槽。
